Document [ES-26]: Form 1040ES-ME, tax year 2026, "Revised: July 2026"
https://www.maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/26_1040es_fillable.pdf

[ES-26] estimated Maine income tax for the year, over and above tax withheld and allowable credits, is $1,000 or more
[ES-26] and if your tax liability for the prior year was also $1,000 or more.
[ES-26] a) An amount equal to the preceding year's tax liability, if the preceding year was a taxable year of 12 months; or
[ES-26] b) An amount equal to 90% of the tax liability for the current taxable year.
[ES-26] exceeds the Maine taxable income received during the same estimated tax installment period of the prior tax year by $500,000 or more.
[ES-26] This special rule prohibits you from utilizing the prior year tax liability rule under paragraph a above
[ES-26] pay in four equal installments on April 15, 2026, June 15, 2026, September 15, 2026, and January 15, 2027.
[ES-26] your estimated tax may be paid in a single installment due on or before January 15, 2027.
[ES-26] If you file your 2026 individual income tax return on or before March 1, 2027, and pay the total tax at that time
(research, not a quote) [ES-26] (revised July 2026) does not mention the relief.

Document [2210-25]: Form 2210ME and instructions, tax year 2025
https://www.maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/25_form_2210_fillable.pdf

[2210-25] line 7: Multiply the amount on line 6 by .25 (to compute the amount for line 9).
[2210-25] line 8 column B: June 16, 2025
[2210-25] Do not calculate the penalty for the 4th required payment if ... the tax is paid in full by January 31.
[2210-25] line 10a: Tax withheld. Enter 25% (0.25) of line 3 in each column.
[2210-25] Subtract line 3 from line 1. If the result is less than $1,000, do not complete or file this form.
[2210-25] line 5: If less than $1,000, do not complete or file this form.
[2210-25] line 5: If short year, enter the amount from line 2.
[2210-25] To calculate your actual liability, complete the Annualized Installment Worksheet for each payment due date and check the box on line 17
[2210-25] For calendar year 2026, the penalty rate is .75% per month or fraction thereof, compounded monthly.
[2210-25] line 13: A part of a month is considered a whole month.
[2210-25] your 2024 tax liability before tax credits, income tax withholding or any other tax payment(s) for the tax year was $1,000 or more
(research, not a quote) Its line 5 measures 2024 tax after refundable credits (line 24 minus lines 25c, 25d and 25e).
(research, not a quote) Whole months, monthly compounding, ends at the earlier of payment or the 15th day of the fourth month | VERIFIED ([2210-25] lines 12 and 13)

Document [AI-25]: Annualized Income Installment Worksheet (Form 2210ME Annualized), tax year 2025
https://www.maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/25_1040me_form2210_ann_fillable.pdf

(research, not a quote) Periods are the federal ones: 1/1 to 3/31, 5/31, 8/31 and 12/31.
(research, not a quote) Factors are 4, 2.4, 1.5 and 1, and percentages 22.5%, 45%, 67.5% and 90% [AI-25].

Document [GEN-25]: 2025 Form 1040ME General Instructions
https://www.maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/25_1040me_gen_instr_w_cover_pg.pdf

(research, not a quote) [MRS-5228](9) was amended by P.L. 2025, c. 113, effective September 24, 2025 [GEN-25].
(research, not a quote) [GEN-25] mentions only payment. The statute governs.
